engineeringSkip.reason: Femtotech as described — using unspecified 'high-energy density fields' to restructure atomic nuclei and subatomic particles — has no basis in known physics or any real research programme, unlike nuclear physics or femtosecond chemistry.

factCheck.reason: There is no such field — nuclei can be split or fused in reactors and accelerators, but the idea of reshaping subatomic particles with vague 'high-energy density fields' at a femtometre scale is a science-fiction label, not real research.
